summary: Cuprina Holdings (Cayman) Limited filed a Form 6-K on October 1, 2026 disclosing that its wholly-owned BVI subsidiary entered into two sale and purchase agreements to acquire 100% of East Coast Podiatry Centre Pte. Ltd. (Target A) and Orchard Clinic Management Pte. Ltd. (Target B) from separate seller groups. Aggregate consideration totals approximately S$4.0 million, split between upfront cash, deferred cash at the first and second anniversaries, and equity issued as 60,334 and 241,337 Class A shares valued at S$3.31 per share. Completion is expected by November 1, 2026, and targets will become wholly-owned subsidiaries; shares represent roughly 3.79% of the enlarged share class and are subject to lock-ups. Investors should watch the pending EGM approval for authorized share capital increase and potential dilution from the equity component, with closing risk if the EGM fails.
